concerns.text: The plan assumes a default CI run processes 200 samples per model (three models) with a per‑commit timeout of 60 s, which in the worst case could require up to 3 × 200 × 60 s ≈ 10 hours of wall‑clock time. This exceeds the stated CI wall‑clock limit of ≤ 6 h on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner, making the pipeline infeasible as written. The adaptive down‑sampling clause only triggers when a timeout occurs, but does not guarantee the total runtime stays within the 6 h budget. The plan must reduce the default sample size, parallelise safely, or otherwise ensure the full CI run completes within the allocated resources.
